# REWIND backend API

<!-- Generated by backend/tests/api_examples.py from real TestClient calls. Do not edit by hand: run `$env:REWIND_REGENERATE = "1"; python -m pytest -q` then remove the variable. -->

Scope: Undo supports **customer status changes only**. This is not a universal rollback.

```powershell
$env:REWIND_DEMO_MODE = "1"; Set-Location backend; uvicorn main:app --reload
```

Base URL `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. CORS allows only `FRONTEND_ORIGIN` (default `http://localhost:5173`; read at startup).

## Envelope

Every response, success or error, is:

```json
{"data": <payload or null>, "error": null | {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": ...}}
```

- `error` is `null` **exactly** when the HTTP status is 2xx.
- Some non-2xx responses still carry `data` (the recorded outcome): policy blocks, Undo conflicts, and unverified/failed writes. Show `error.message`, and use `data` for detail.
- Show "verified" only when `verification.verdict == "verified"`.

## Refresh advice

- After **any** POST (update, Undo, reset), refetch `GET /api/customers` and `GET /api/actions`. Responses are not pushed; there is no websocket.
- Never compute Undo eligibility in the UI: use `undo_available` / `undo_disabled_reason` from the latest `GET /api/actions`. They are evaluated against the current customer row on every read.
- Polling is optional; if you poll, every 2–5 s is plenty for the demo.

## When Undo is enabled

| Situation | `undo_available` | `undo_disabled_reason` |
|---|---|---|
| Executed status change, customer unchanged since | `true` | `null` |
| Executed, Undo failed before (`recovery_state: restore_failed`) | `true` | `null` |
| Already undone (`recovery_state: recovered`) | `false` | Already undone |
| Customer edited since (version or any field differs) | `false` | Customer changed since this action; Undo would overwrite a newer edit |
| Action was `blocked` / `rejected` / `pending_approval` / `failed` | `false` | Action was blocked; there is no change to undo |
| The row is itself an Undo record | `false` | This is an Undo record; undoing an Undo is not supported |

## Status codes (from the examples below)

| Route | Status | `error.code` | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/demo/reset` | 200 | — | Reset the demo |
| `GET /api/customers` | 200 | — | List customers |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 200 | — | Archive an inactive customer |
| `GET /api/actions/{action_id}` | 200 | — | Get one action (Undo available) |
| `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/undo` | 200 | — | Undo it |
| `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/undo` | 200 | — | Undo it again (idempotent) |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 403 | `policy_blocked` | Blocked: protected customer |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 403 | `policy_blocked` | Blocked: recently active |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 409 | `policy_blocked` | Blocked: already has that status |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 409 | `version_conflict` | Stale expected_version |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 404 | `customer_not_found` | Unknown account |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 422 | `invalid_arguments` | Malformed arguments |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 200 | — | Archive another customer |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 200 | — | Someone else edits that customer |
| `GET /api/actions/{action_id}` | 200 | — | Get the earlier action (Undo now disabled) |
| `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/undo` | 409 | `undo_conflict` | Undo after a newer edit: conflict |
| `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/undo` | 409 | `not_undoable` | Undo a blocked action |
| `POST /api/actions/{action_id}/undo` | 404 | `action_not_found` | Undo an unknown action |
| `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status` | 202 | — | Bulk run over threshold (threshold set to 1) |
| `GET /api/actions` | 200 | — | List actions |
| `POST /api/agent/runs` | 501 | `not_implemented` | Reserved: start an agent run |
| `GET /api/runs/run-1/evidence` | 501 | `not_implemented` | Reserved: run evidence |
| `GET /api/nope` | 404 | `route_not_found` | Unknown route |
| `POST /api/demo/reset` | 403 | `demo_mode_off` | Reset with demo mode off |

## Configuration (env vars)

| Var | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `REWIND_DB_PATH` | `backend/data/rewind.db` | SQLite file |
| `REWIND_DEMO_MODE` | off | `1` enables reset and the fixed demo clock (2026-10-22T12:00:00Z) |
| `FRONTEND_ORIGIN` | `http://localhost:5173` | The only origin allowed by CORS |
| `REWIND_RECENT_ACTIVITY_DAYS` | `90` | Archiving a customer active within N days is blocked |
| `REWIND_BULK_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD` | `3` | Executed changes per `run_id` before approval is required |
| `REWIND_FAULT_DISABLE_RECENT_ACTIVITY` | off | Injected fault (demo mode only): disables only `recent_activity`; affected actions carry `scenario: "injected_fault"` |

## Routes, with real requests and responses

IDs and timestamps are fixed for the docs; every other value is what the app returned.

### `POST /api/tools/update-customer-status`

Body: `account_id`, `new_status`, `reason` (required, 1–500 chars), optional `expected_version`, optional `run_id`. Unknown keys are rejected.

#### Archive an inactive customer

```http
POST /api/tools/update-customer-status
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "account_id": "ACC-102",
  "new_status": "Archived",
  "reason": "Inactive for 591 days",
  "expected_version": 1,
  "run_id": "run-1"
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "action_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
    "decision": "allow",
    "rule_id": "default_allow",
    "reason": null,
    "risk": "medium",
    "scenario": null,
    "before": {
      "account_id": "ACC-102",
      "name": "Meera Iyer",
      "status": "Active",
      "last_activity_at": "2025-03-10T12:00:00Z",
      "protected": false,
      "version": 1
    },
    "status": "executed",
    "recovery_state": "available",
    "after": {
      "account_id": "ACC-102",
      "name": "Meera Iyer",
      "status": "Archived",
      "last_activity_at": "2025-03-10T12:00:00Z",
      "protected": false,
      "version": 2
    },
    "verification": {
      "verdict": "verified",
      "stage": "pre_commit_guard",
      "scope": "Pre-commit guard for the status update of customer ACC-102, inside the write transaction: UPDATE row count, the row's status and version as re-read in that transaction, and a hash of all other rows in customers table. Committed data is not re-read here.",
      "checks": [
        {
          "id": "one_row_updated",
          "description": "The status update UPDATE changed exactly one customers row",
          "expected": 1,
          "actual": 1,
          "passed": true
        },
        {
          "id": "status_written",
          "description": "Target row's status, re-read inside the same transaction",
          "expected": "Archived",
          "actual": "Archived",
          "passed": true
        },
        {
          "id": "version_incremented_by_one",
          "description": "Target row's version, re-read inside the same transaction",
          "expected": 2,
          "actual": 2,
          "passed": true
        },
        {
          "id": "other_customers_unchanged_in_transaction",
          "description": "Count and SHA-256 of all other rows in customers table, before vs after the UPDATE, inside the same transaction",
          "expected": {
            "row_count": 7,
            "sha256": "ea60b90e07f72a4396e4987a46a5a5d8d361b9c69ba742bb661724c4876e6fbb"
          },
          "actual": {
            "row_count": 7,
            "sha256": "ea60b90e07f72a4396e4987a46a5a5d8d361b9c69ba742bb661724c4876e6fbb"
          },
          "passed": true
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "error": null
}
```

#### Bulk run over threshold (threshold set to 1)

Setup: one change already executed in `run-bulk`, with `REWIND_BULK_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD=1`. No customer change is made; no approval UI exists yet.

```http
POST /api/tools/update-customer-status
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "account_id": "ACC-102",
  "new_status": "Archived",
  "reason": "Inactive for 591 days",
  "run_id": "run-bulk"
}
```

Response `202`:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "action_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012",
    "decision": "require_approval",
    "rule_id": "bulk_change",
    "reason": "Run already executed 1 changes (threshold 1)",
    "risk": "medium",
    "scenario": null,
    "before": {
      "account_id": "ACC-102",
      "name": "Meera Iyer",
      "status": "Active",
      "last_activity_at": "2025-03-10T12:00:00Z",
      "protected": false,
      "version": 3
    },
    "status": "pending_approval",
    "after": {
      "account_id": "ACC-102",
      "name": "Meera Iyer",
      "status": "Active",
      "last_activity_at": "2025-03-10T12:00:00Z",
      "protected": false,
      "version": 3
    }
  },
  "error": null
}
```

{
  "data": {
    "action_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008",

      "version": 3

    "differences": {
      "status": {
        "expected": "Archived",
        "current": "Active"
      },
      "version": {
        "expected": 2,
        "current": 3
      }
    },
    "verification": {
      "verdict": "conflict_detected",
      "stage": "post_commit",
      "scope": "After commit, on a new SQLite connection: confirmed customer ACC-105 still differs from the recorded after-state and was not written by the Undo attempt, the attempt is in the ledger, and PRAGMA integrity_check.",
      "checks": [
        {
          "id": "conflict_evidence",
          "description": "Customer row still differs from the action's recorded after-state",
          "expected": {
            "matches_recorded_after_state": false
          },
          "actual": {
            "matches_recorded_after_state": false
          },
          "passed": true
        },
        {
          "id": "customer_not_written",
          "description": "Customer version unchanged since the conflict was detected (Undo wrote nothing)",
          "expected": 3,
          "actual": 3,
          "passed": true
        },
        {
          "id": "ledger_consistency",
          "description": "Undo ledger row read back on a new connection (so it is committed), references the original action, and the original's recovery_state matches",
          "expected": {
            "tool_name": "undo",
            "status": "conflict_detected",
            "undo_of_action_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008",
            "original_recovery_state": "conflict_detected"
          },
          "actual": {
            "tool_name": "undo",
            "status": "conflict_detected",
            "undo_of_action_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008",
            "original_recovery_state": "conflict_detected"
          },
          "passed": true
        },
        {
          "id": "db_integrity",
          "description": "PRAGMA integrity_check on a new connection",
          "expected": "ok",
          "actual": "ok",
          "passed": true
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "error": {
    "code": "undo_conflict",
    "message": "Customer changed since this action; Undo would overwrite a newer edit",
    "details": {
      "differences": {
        "status": {
          "expected": "Archived",
          "current": "Active"
        },
        "version": {
          "expected": 2,
          "current": 3
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

## Changes since the last version (Priority-0 item 4)

- **Breaking:** every response is wrapped in `{data, error}`. `GET /api/customers` and `GET /api/actions` now return their arrays under `data`.
- **Breaking:** errors are `{data: null, error: {...}}` (was `{error: {...}}`). Policy blocks (`policy_blocked`), Undo conflicts (`undo_conflict`), and unverified writes now also set `error`.
- New on every action: `undo_available`, `undo_disabled_reason`.
- New: `POST /api/agent/runs` and `GET /api/runs/{run_id}/evidence` reserved (501).
- Unknown routes and 405s use the envelope (`route_not_found`, `method_not_allowed`).
- CORS enabled for `FRONTEND_ORIGIN` only.
